title: stenocereus weberi
intro: Stenocereus weberi, commonly known as the Weber's Pitahaya or Pitaya Amarilla, is a type of cactus native to the Sonoran Desert in Mexico. It has been traditionally used in Mexican folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stenocereus weberi include analgesic, anti-edematous, and anti-hemorrhagic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. Additionally, its bioactive compounds, including carotenoids and betacyanins, have been reported to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-cancer activities.
